name: Raindrop Glasshouse
description: A giant glasshouse shaped like a falling raindrop contains a lush indoor rainforest and a tiny raincloud.
prompt: A single breathtaking architectural fantasy of a giant glasshouse shaped like a suspended raindrop, standing in a misty valley. Inside, a lush tropical rainforest flourishes around a small floating raincloud that drizzles onto orchids and ferns. Reflections on curved glass, soft gray-green light, delicate steel ribs, dreamy and elegant, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: A whole rainforest inside a raindrop. Would you step into this glass storm?
